y-m-54-04.title: Kutheni elinye lamaxabiso amabini lingesosisombululo?
y-m-54-04.topic: Ukuhlola amaxabiso afunyenweyo xa kusonjululwa ulingano olunamaxabiso aphelele
y-m-54-04.goal: Fumana apho ingqikelelo ethi 'onke amaxabiso aphuma ekusombululeni zizisombululo' iphuka khona kwisisombululo se-|x-1|=2x, uze ucacise ngendlela yakho ukuba kutheni kusala isisombululo esi-1 kuphela.
y-m-54-04.material: USeoa wacombulula ulingano |x-1| = 2x. U-x linani lenyani. |x-1| ifundwa 'ixabiso eliphelele lika-x ukhuphe 1.' Isisombululo sikaSeoa silapha ngezantsi.
y-m-54-04.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ucinga unikezelo lobunzima (H2) lomkhondo 'weMathematika Esisiseko 1 yesikolo samabanga aphezulu' kwaye awubonisi ukuba lo mxholo ufundwa kwiliphi ibanga (iindlela zezikolo ziyahluka). Intsingiselo yexabiso eliphelele (umgama ukusuka ku-0 kumgca wamanani, ohlala u-0 okanye ngaphezulu) nenqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi lokusombulula iilingano ezithe tye.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sikaSeoa. (Imigca ibalwa ukusuka ku-1.)
y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.0: Combulula imigca 1 ukuya ku-3 kwakhona ukuhlola ibalo ngalinye, uze ujonge ukuba sisiphi isibakala esitsha esenziwa kwimigca elandelayo.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amaxabiso amabini enye ngenye kulingano lokuqala |x-1|=2x uze ubale macala omabini.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.4: La ngamaxabiso amabini afunyenwe ngokusombulula, ngoko omabini ngezisombululo zolu lingano.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.explain: Imigca 4 no-5. Kwinkqubo yokusombulula, akukho kuqinisekiswa kokuba izisombululo zamabinzana avela kwiimeko ezahlulweyo zizisombululo zolingano lokuqala. Ukuba ufaka x=-1 kulingano lokuqala, icala lasekhohlo li-|-2|=2 kwaye icala lasekunene li-2×(-1)=-2, ezahlukileyo. Kwi-x=1/3, icala lasekhohlo li-2/3 kwaye icala lasekunene li-2/3, ezihambelanayo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba ufaka x=-1 kulingano lokuqala, icala lasekhohlo li-|-1-1|=2 kwaye icala lasekunene li-2×(-1)=-2. Khetha oko kufanelekileyo kakhulu ukuthi ukusuka kwesi siphumo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba lelona xabiso lincinci icala lasekhohlo |x-1| elinokuba nalo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenza ukuba ulingano lunokusebenza na kuluhlu luka-x apho icala lasekunene 2x linegethivu.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.a: |x-1| ngu-0 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa 2x inegethivu, ngoko ayihambelani
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.a: Oku kukucinga okuqala kujonge uluhlu lwamaxabiso elinokuba nalo icala elinye lolingano.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.b: Ngenxa yexabiso eliphelele, amanani anezimpawu ezahlukileyo anokubonwa njengenani elinye, ngoko nalo sisisombululo
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.b: Ixabiso eliphelele licima uphawu kuphela kwicala lasekhohlo. Alinampembelelo kwicala lasekunene 2x.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.c: Kwakukho impazamo yokubala, kwaye ukuba ucombulula kwakhona omabini amaxabiso zizisombululo
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba uyibiza ngempazamo nangona ibalo lokufaka lichanekile, usenokuba awuyithembi into oyihloliweyo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.d: Usenokuba ukhethe nje elinye ngolandelelwano ungafakanga omabini amaxabiso ukuhlola. Faka no-1/3 nawo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.explain: |x-1| ihlala ingu-0 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko 2x kufuneka ibe ngu-0 okanye ngaphezulu nayo. Kwi-x=-1, 2x inegethivu, ngoko ayihambelani, kwaye kwi-x=1/3 macala omabini angama-2/3. Ngoko isisombululo esiyodwa yi-x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.prompt: Endaweni yendlela kaSeoa, bhala enye indlela ebonisa ukuba x=1/3 sisona sisombululo esiyodwa. Ngokomzekelo: misela uluhlu luka-x kuqala, okanye wahlule ibe x≥1 no-x<1. Bhala nokuba kutheni x=-1 asisosisombululo.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka x=-1 kumacala omabini olingano lokuqala uze uthelekise iimpawu.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ixabiso eliphelele lingaba maxabiso amangaphi ubuncinane, uze ubhale ukuba yeyiphi imeko enamathele kwibinzana lasekunene.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ungacacisa apho indlela yam ibeka 'isizathu sokuhluza isisombululo' ngokwahlukileyo kwendlela kaSeoa?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uhlole ngokufaka kulingano lokuqala ukuba x=1/3 sisisombululo ngenene?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba isizathu sokulahla u-x=-1 sicacile, nokuba ngoluhlu okanye ngokufaka endaweni?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.0: |x-1| ngu-0 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko 2x kufuneka ibe ngu-0 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko x≥0. Emva koko x=-1 uyalahlwa kwaye kusala x=1/3 kuphela. Ukuba ufaka u-1/3, macala omabini alingana no-2/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.1: Xa x≥1, x-1=2x inika x=-1, kodwa oko akuyonto x≥1, ngoko akusebenzi. Xa x<1, 1-x=2x inika x=1/3, onanelisa x<1. Ngoko isisombululo esiyodwa yi-x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yafikelela kwisigqibo esifanayo ngendlela yokwahlula uluhlu.

y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.after: f(0)=-3<0, ngoko x=0 iquliwe ngokuqinisekileyo. Imo yi-U yaye f(-2) no-f(4) zingqina, ngoko ama-x one-f(x)<0 anokuba phakathi kwe-−2 nesi-4 kuphela. Kodwa asikazi imida echanekileyo. 'c' no 'd' zombini ziinyaniso ezahlukeneyo ezinokuthiwa ngokuqinisekileyo ngoku.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe kuphela amanqaku apho ixabiso lihlolwe njengezisombululo. Asikayazi amaxabiso phakathi kwamanqaku, kodwa singasebenzisa imo ye-U.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ugqibe ukuba yonke into engaphakathi i-negative ngokubona nje ukuba amaxabiso eziphelo i-positive. Asikayazi amaxabiso phakathi kwe-0 ne--2.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ukuba zikho x ezinelisa f(x)<0, zonke ziphakathi kwe--2 ne-4
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Oku kukucinga okusebenzisa imo ye-U nezimpawu zamaxabiso eziphelo kunye.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ucinga ntoni ngoluhlu lwe-x enelisa f(x)<0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Kwimo ye-U, f li-0 kwi--1 nakwi-3, ngoko i-negative phakathi kwazo kwaye i-positive ngaphandle. f(x)<0 ithetha 'ingaphantsi kwe-0,' ngoko imida --1 no-3 ayiqukwanga, kunika -1<x<3. Ayiphikisani no-x=0, obuthe uqinisekile kwinyathelo langaphambili, ukuba ngaphakathi koluhlu olu.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ujonge ixesha le-negative nexesha le-positive lemo ye-U ngokuchanekileyo ngolunye uhlangothi. Hlola ukuba lihambelana no-f(0)=-3 na.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Nangona ubone ukuba f li-0 kwimida --1 no-3, uzifake phantsi kwemeko 'ingaphantsi kwe-0.'
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uthathe kuphela amanqaku apho f li-0 njengezisombululo. La manqaku ayizo amaxabiso angaphantsi kwe-0.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Imeko itshintshile. Lo msebenzi yi-f(x)=x²-2x-3. (Ungahlola ngokubala ngokuthe ngqo ukuba uhambelana namaxabiso onke etheyibhileni.) Ngoku umbuzo ngoluhlu lwe-x apho f(x)≤0, oko kukuthi 'li-0 okanye ingaphantsi.'
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ucinga ntoni ngoluhlu lwe-x enelisa f(x)≤0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.after: f(-1)=0 no-f(3)=0 zikwi-0 okanye ngaphantsi, ngoko imida iqukiwe, kunika -1≤x≤3. Xa uphawu lokungalingani lutshintsha ukusuka ku-< ukuya ku-≤, amaxabiso emida ayangena kwisisombululo.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Awubonisanga ukuba ≤ iquka 'ilingana.' Jonga ukuba f(-1) no-f(3) zintoni.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubone ≤, watshintshela kumaxesha angaphandle. Hlola ukuba f(0)=-3 li-0 okanye ingaphantsi.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uthathe kuphela inqaku eliqinisekisiweyo njengesisombululo. Ingaba amaxabiso angaphakathi nawo onke li-0 okanye ngaphantsi?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.reflect: Ngamaxabiso ambalwa etheyibhileni, ungahlula 'oko kuqinisekileyo (uphawu lwamaxabiso omsebenzi, uluhlu olufunyenwe kwimo ye-U)' no-'oko kungekaziwa (imida ncam),' kwaye njengoko ulwazi lukhula, uluhlu oluqinisekileyo luyancipha.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.prompt: Esi sisisombululo sikaSeungu esifumene isisombululo sika-f(x)<0 xa f(x)=x²-2x-3. Khetha umgca omnye ophosakeleyo. (Imigca ibalwa ukususela kwi-1.)
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=-3 kwisiphumo somgca 4, x<3, ubale ukuba ukungalingani kokuqala f(x)<0 kuyabamba na.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hlela kwitheyibhile ukuba zeziphi iindibaniselwano zeempawu ezenza imveliso ibe yi-negative.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.2: Imveliso i-negative, ngoko x+1<0 okanye x-3<0.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.3: Ngoko x<-1 okanye x<3, oko kukuthi x<3.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.explain: Umgca 3 (nomgca 4, osisiphumo sawo) yingxaki. Ukuze imveliso ibe yi-negative, iimpawu zeemvelisi ezimbini kufuneka zahluke. Ukuba uthi 'ubuncinane enye yi-negative,' iquka imeko apho zombini iimvelisi zi-negative, kwaye ngoko imveliso i-positive. Umzekelo, ukuba x=-3, ngoko (-2)(-6)=12, i-positive. Impendulo echanekileyo yi--1<x<3. (Ukukhetha umgca 3 okanye umgca 4 kwamkelwa njengokuchanekileyo.)
